title: Testing Node.js APIs Knowledge Check
description: Check your understanding of backend test strategy, test runners, unit tests, Supertest API tests, mocks, integration tests, and E2E tradeoffs.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: What should most backend tests focus on?

options.text: The exact line count of source files

questions.explanation: Behavior-focused tests survive refactors better and verify what callers rely on.

questions.prompt: What is Supertest commonly used for?

options.text: Testing HTTP APIs without manually starting a real external server

questions.explanation: Supertest can exercise Express and Node HTTP handlers through request-like assertions.

options.text: When isolating code from slow, flaky, or expensive external dependencies

questions.explanation: Mocks help isolate behavior, but over-mocking can make tests less realistic.

questions.prompt: What is a useful role for integration tests?

options.text: Checking that multiple real parts work together across a boundary

questions.explanation: Integration tests are valuable for database, API, queue, or service boundaries where wiring matters.
